text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — next week launch + webinar bump. Need final X + LinkedIn post set (three caption variants each), hero GIF, registration CTA, and SDR routing doc. Who can own final captions and UTM mapping?

Priya Patel: I can own captions. Will draft 3 variants for each platform by EOD today. Do we want a short-form thread for X (4 tweets) + a long form LinkedIn post?

Tom Briggs: Designer — I can do the hero GIF and 2 static sized images. ETA tomorrow noon. Need copy length constraints for X thread and LinkedIn header.

Diego Rivera: For X thread we should do: 1) headline, 2) pain stat, 3) benchmark result, 4) CTA + webinar link. Will mock a 4-tweet flow. Also can make a 1-slide carousel for LinkedIn.

Ben Lowe: For SDR routing: please ensure registration form includes "company size" and "use case" fields. We route >500 ARR to Enterprise SDRs, mid-market to Growth. I'll update the routing doc and post link here.

postbot: Auto-schedule check — available posting windows next week: Tue 09:00 PT, Wed 12:00 PT, Thu 16:00 PT. Can reserve one slot once assets are uploaded.

Maria Chen: Priya + Tom — ringfence Wed 12:00 PT as primary push and Thu 16:00 PT as boost. Priya, can you make the first LinkedIn variant webinar-focused and the second benchmark-story? Third should be technical for eng audiences.

Priya Patel: Yep. Drafts coming up. Also adding UTM template: utm_source=x_social / linkedin_social, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=launch_v1. Any objections?

Ben Lowe: UTM OK. Add utm_content for variant id (a/b/c) so SDRs can see which creative drove leads.

Tom Briggs: Uploaded two hero options: "hero_gif_v1.mp4" and "hero_static_v2.png" to /marketing/assets/launch-2026. Using 1.91:1 and 1080x1080. Priya — please confirm which to use for which variant.

Diego Rivera: Quick copy suggestion for tweet 2 (pain stat): "Teams spend 3–4x more time tuning inference vs shipping features — here’s how we cut costs by 2.3x." feedback?

Maria Chen: Love it. Tone = punchy, numbers-forward. Also we need a short thread reply template for engagement follow-ups: one-liner thanking + ask to book demo link if they comment. Draft below: 
```
Thanks — great point! If you want a quick walkthrough I can show how the benchmark was run and share the eval prompts: https://redwood.com/demo (or register for the webinar)
```

Priya Patel: That follow-up works. I'll add a softer variant for LinkedIn comments.

Ben Lowe: Routing doc link: https://docs.internal/redwood/sdr-routing/launch-2026 — updated rules and Slack ping channel #leads-launch. I'll export CSV to the CRM after webinar.

Maria Chen: Two final asks: 1) Add short caption for the registration form confirmation email (Tom/Priya). 2) Can someone draft 3 quick Prompts for the webinar demo that we can publish as follow-up content?

Tom Briggs: I'll draft the email header image + confirm copy tomorrow.

Priya Patel: I'll write the 3 webinar prompts and the confirmation email copy by EOD tomorrow.

Diego Rivera: I'll schedule a rehearsal with product on Mon. Pinged @ProductOps.

Maria Chen: Perfect — circling back Friday AM with final assets. If anyone hits a blocker, drop updates here. :thumbsup:
